newsitem.title: USA: Cambridge Energy to merge with McCarthy, Crisanti.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Energy to merge with McCarthy, Crisanti.

text.p: Cambridge Energy Research Associates and McCarthy, Crisanti & Maffei Inc are to merge, the companies said on Monday.

Cambridge Energy Research, a privately-held company which provides information and analysis on the global energy industry, said that the new group, to be known as Global Decisions Group, will have more that $70 million in revenues this year.
Privately-held McCarthy, Crisanti provides analysis of global fixed income markets.

"This combination with MCM enables us to meet the expanding needs of energy companies by bringing together CERA's capability in the energy business with MCM's knowledge of the economic and financial markets," said Daniel Yergin, president of Cambridge Energy Research.
The new company will be based in New York.
